environment.description: AWS Step Functions workflow with API Gateway trigger. The ValidateSessionToken Lambda is invoked via a public API Gateway endpoint (REST API, no authorization). The Step Functions execution is started synchronously via StartSyncExecution, and the Lambda output (including error messages) is returned directly to the caller in the API Gateway response body. No rate limiting configured. CloudWatch logs at INFO level.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no auth, proxy integration to Step Functions StartSyncExecution
config.response_mapping: passthrough - full Lambda output returned to client
